input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: A CSV with a header row `rnaseq_id,directories`. `rnaseq_id` is a unique sample identifier; `directories` is the path to a directory containing that sample's FASTQ files.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

reference_name.description: Prefix of the reference FASTA file inside star_dir (e.g. GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set for GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fa).

ref_genome_version.description: Reference genome version. FreeBayes, Isofox and MINTIE only run with hs38.

genome_lib_dir.description: Path to the CTAT genome library directory (STAR-Fusion).

star_dir.description: Path to the STAR reference directory (also contains <reference_name>.fa).

gtf_file.description: Path to gene annotation GTF file.

ensg2hgnc_file.description: Path to ENSG to HGNC gene mapping CSV file.

optional_reference_files.title: Optional reference files
optional_reference_files.description: Optional parameters that can be provided to customize the analysis. Omitting a parameter skips the corresponding tool.

rnaindel_dir.description: Path to RNAIndel data directory (optional - if not provided, RNAINDEL analysis will be skipped).

ensembl_data_dir.description: Path to Ensembl data directory (optional - if not provided, ISOFOX analysis will be skipped).

mixcr_license.description: Path to MiXCR license file (optional - if not provided, MIXCR analysis will be skipped).

te_gtf_file.description: Path to transposable element GTF file (optional - if not provided, TECOUNT analysis will be skipped).

freebayes_interval_list.description: Optional BED interval list for targeted analysis (if not provided, FREEBAYES analysis will be skipped).

mintie_dir.description: Path to MINTIE reference directory (optional - if not provided, MINTIE analysis will be skipped).

annovar_dir.description: Path to ANNOVAR data directory (optional - if not provided, ANNOVAR analysis will be skipped).

gatk_interval_list.description: Optional interval list for targeted analysis in GATK HaplotypeCaller.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for typical pipeline runs.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used by publishDir to save results.

allsorts_version.description: ALLSorts model version passed to the ALLSorts container.

arriba_version.description: Arriba version used to locate the database files bundled in the Arriba container.
